fig.caption: Anterior view of the band of dermatitis encircling the neck (Casal's necklace)This is a photosensitive dermatitis. The upper border of the dermatitis at the neck is spared as light exposure is obstructed by the chin, while the lower border is dependent on the clothing of the patient.
